task: Review this fictional test description from a health-communication training packet. Identify the missing denominator information that prevents the stated accuracy figure from being interpretable.
input: The Primoscreen test correctly identified the condition in 92 percent of cases it analysed.

facts.text: The fictional Primoscreen test is described in a health-communication training packet.
The 92 percent figure is supplied in the packet.
The packet does not state the population to which the percentage applies: true positives only, all positives tested, or all patients tested.
The packet does not supply a false-positive rate or specificity figure.

forbidden_additions: An invented specificity or false-positive rate.
A clinical recommendation based on the 92 percent figure.
A claim that 92 percent is a sensitivity or positive predictive value.
preserve: The fact that its denominator population is unspecified.
The separate observation that a false-positive rate is also absent.
